turns.question: Which customer country brought in the most revenue per buying customer in September 2026, and how much per customer?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no revenue-per-buying-customer metric (closest: revenue_eur, customers_distinct and average_order_value_eur), so I can't give a per-customer figure; for 1-30 September 2026 revenue (active customers) were DE 2,665.50 EUR (2), GB 2,634.00 EUR (2), TR 2,412.00 EUR (2), NL 2,408.00 EUR (2), FR 1,241.00 EUR (1), US 1,222.25 EUR (1). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
